mapper.sql: select m.remind_id, m.remind_type, m.buyer_id, m.station_id, m.batch_id, m.pool_id, m.seq, m.content, m.plan_send_at, m.status, m.sent_at, m.create_time, bu.buyer_name, s.station_name, b.batch_no from gas_remind m left join gas_buyer bu on m.buyer_id = bu.buyer_id left join gas_station s on m.station_id = s.station_id left join gas_purchase_batch b on m.batch_id = b.batch_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from gas_remind where remind_type = #{remindType} and ((#{batchId} = 0 and batch_id = 0) or (#{batchId} != 0 and batch_id = #{batchId})) and ((#{poolId} = 0 and pool_id = 0) or (#{poolId} != 0 and pool_id = #{poolId}))
mapper.insert: insert into gas_remind(remind_type, buyer_id, station_id, batch_id, pool_id, seq, content, plan_send_at, status, create_time) values(#{remindType}, #{buyerId}, #{stationId}, #{batchId}, #{poolId}, #{seq}, #{content}, #{planSendAt}, 'PENDING', sysdate())
mapper.select: where m.status = 'PENDING' and m.plan_send_at <= sysdate() order by m.plan_send_at
mapper.update: update gas_remind set status = #{status}, sent_at = sysdate() where remind_id = #{remindId}
